Gabriela Vianna Cé [ 1 ] (born 3 March 1993) is a Brazilian professional tennis player. She has a career-high WTA singles ranking of No. 221, achieved on 9 September 2019 and a best doubles ranking of No. 109, reached on 18 April 2016. [ 2 ] She has won one WTA Challenger title and multiple trophies on ITF Women's Tour . Playing for the Brazil Fed Cup team , Cé has a win–loss record of 11–9.
